categories_thin: Land surveying: no land-surveying firm with a Franklin Township/Somerset office was found. Cylex has no Somerset land-surveyor category results; the surveyors that surfaced (Stires Associates in Somerville, Titus Surveying in North Plainfield, Parker Engineering in Somerville, DPK Consulting in Edison) are all outside the zone.

Real estate appraisal: only one appraisal-type listing in-zone (PDA Property Damage Appraisers, a franchise insurance-damage network, so excluded). Residential appraisal firms surfaced in Piscataway, North Brunswick, Edison and Somerville.
Architecture: only one architecture practice confirmed in-zone (DRG Architects). Cylex's architect category for Somerset returned mainly New Brunswick, Milltown and Piscataway firms.
Title agencies: two in-zone title agencies only (Seamless Title, All County Title). Most title companies serving 08873 sit on Route 18/Stelton Rd or in Somerville/New Brunswick.

Franklin Park (08823): still sparse - only ASM Tax Office has a confirmed 08823 address; the Route 27/Finnegans Lane corridor there is mostly small offices that directories assign to Kendall Park or North Brunswick.

Environmental/geotechnical engineering: the offices in-zone were largely branches of national or multi-state firms (Terracon, GZA, Roux, LaBella, D&B, GTA) which are excluded, leaving only a handful of local firms (Excel, Envocare, Environmental Reports, EG&R, Axis, Sigma, Daystar).
caveats: RULE APPLIED FOR MULTI-OFFICE FIRMS (fixes the inconsistency the checker flagged): a business is excluded when its local site is a branch of a firm headquartered outside New Jersey or a firm with offices in several states, and when it is a branded chain or franchise (including franchise insurance agencies, staffing brands and radio groups). Firms headquartered in New Jersey, including multi-office NJ practices, are kept and flagged in notes. Removed under this rule this round: Terracon (HQ Olathe, KS, 200+ offices), GZA GeoEnvironmental (HQ Norwood, MA), LaBella Associates/Prestige Environmental (HQ Rochester NY; acquired Prestige in May 2026), Roux Associates, D&B Engineers and Architects (NY), Whitman, Geo-Technology Associates, PIB Law / Parker Ibrahim & Berg (multi-state), ProLogistix and Remedy (Employbridge brands), PROMAN/Paramount, Beasley Media Group, WFG Somerset (World Financial Group affiliate), T.E. Freuler Agency (division of World Insurance Associates). Also excluded as chains/branches: Marsh & McLennan, Aon, the Hanover regional office, MetLife, Bankers Life, Citizens/Citibank branches, Experis, Kelly Services, Eliassen Group, Net2Source, 22nd Century Technologies, SHI, GalaxE.Solutions, Kronos, CareCloud/MTBC, H&R Block, Jackson Hewitt, Liberty Tax, and State Farm / Allstate / Ameriprise / Keller Williams / Century 21 / RE/MAX offices.

ENTRIES REMOVED AS WRONG TOWN OR WRONG ADDRESS (per the checker): Providence Abstract LLC (own contact page gives 2050 Route 27, Unit 209, North Brunswick 08902 - Middlesex County, outside the zone); Technology Concepts Group International (own site now gives 485C Route 1 South, Iselin 08830); Comprehensive Financial Strategies (directories place it at 623 Georges Rd, North Brunswick 08902); Medina Tech Solutions (based in North Brunswick per its own site); Revan Consulting (Easton Ave, New Brunswick 08901); Shah Tax & Accounting Services (Hillsborough 08844, by appointment).

ENTRIES REMOVED BECAUSE ONLY A RESIDENTIAL / HOME ADDRESS WAS PUBLISHED (inference from the street type - court, circle, lane, drive or a numbered house on a residential street with no suite): Churchill Estates LLC (103 Churchill Ave, also confirmed as a single-family house by property listings), Joe Medicare (Apt 14D, 575 Easton Ave), Accumed Script, NASR Technologies, Silent Infotech, biontek Solutions, Mobile Computer Repair, XL Softek, Smartfix LLC, Eco Earth Services, Alsieux Architecture, Wealth Guard Financial Services, Unlimited Financial Services LLC, Social Market Way New Jersey, Rynek Digital, Big Buzz Digital Marketing, WDC Studio, The Trautmann Firm, LP Accounting / LP Tax Services (19 Steeplechase Ct). These are probably real small practices, but publishing a home address is outside the brief's limits; they are listed here by name so they can be re-checked once a business-only address is known.

ENTRIES REMOVED AS UNVERIFIABLE (single obscure directory, no address, or conflicting / no longer operating): Ellen Anne Adesso CPA (obituary published March 2026 - practice presumably closed), Platys Group (no address on any listing; a directory gives Hillsborough), AR Solutions Inc. (one directory only), RDRNJ (no findable business at its Somerset mailbox suite), Professional Staffing Services (131 Codington Ave not found in any source), YMSolutionsnovus LLC (no reproducible source), NYIAX (mailbox suite, corporate HQ elsewhere), Hamilton Street Center (a building, not a business), Skynet Agency (a directory places it in North Brunswick).

HOME-OFFICE / MAIL-DROP FLAGS: several retained entries publish a street address with no suite (Professional Reliable Accounting, Insurico Group, Finkelstein law office, Original Function, August eTech) or a mailbox-style suite number (Garden Mutual 'PMB 1045', NT Bookkeeping '#1824', XYZ Consultants '11-176', plus the '#1088' suite form used on Easton Ave). These are flagged in notes; do not treat them as walk-in offices.

ZONE BORDERLINE, RETAINED WITH A FLAG: AM Professional Services (243 Livingston Ave) and All in Insurance (607 Route 27). Directories list both as Somerset 08873, but both streets run along the New Brunswick city line and the township of record was not confirmed against parcel data. The other two Route 27 insurance listings previously flagged as borderline (Premier Insurance Somerset, Trusted Insurance NJ) could not be re-checked and are not included.

CITATION CHANGE: no Google Maps search URL is used as a citation in this file. Every entry cites either the firm's own page, its individual directory/company page, a chamber or carrier member listing, or a news article. Where a directory blocks automated fetching (Yellow Pages, BBB), details come from the page as opened in a browser or as indexed in search results, and the entry says so.

Bulk-directory entries are marked 'one directory only (Cylex/localitybiz/Yellow Pages)'. Cylex in particular mixes current and stale records (it still lists a CPA who died in 2026), so those entries need a confirmation call before outreach.

Zone = Franklin Township, Somerset County only (Somerset, Franklin Park, East Millstone, Griggstown, Middlebush, Blackwells Mills, Weston, Six Mile Run). Businesses in New Brunswick, North Brunswick, Milltown, East Brunswick, Piscataway, Highland Park, Kendall Park, Hillsborough, Somerville, Bound Brook, South Plainfield, Iselin and Edison were excluded even where they appeared in Somerset-area searches.
data_gaps: Bulk directories block automated access: Yellow Pages, BBB, Cylex company pages, find-open, allpages, Manta and the SCBP chamber directory all returned HTTP 403 to direct page fetches. Cylex category pages were read successfully in a real browser, which is how the bulk of the new names were gathered; individual Cylex company pages were not opened one by one.

No municipal licensed-business or economic-development list was available for Franklin Township, so there is no authoritative roster to reconcile against; coverage rests on directories plus individual firm sites.

OpenStreetMap / Overpass was not used in this revision. Township attribution now comes from each directory's municipality field plus the firm's own site, which is why borderline streets are flagged rather than resolved.

Land surveyors and real estate appraisers remain the weakest categories - no in-zone surveyor found at all, and appraisers are all out of zone. The NJ Society of Professional Land Surveyors member directory and the NJ licensed-title-agency list (nj.gov DOBI) could not be read here and should be checked manually.

Cylex-only entries (roughly 45 of the businesses) have a single source with address and phone. They are legitimate listing records but may include closed or relocated firms; they need a confirmation call or a second directory before use.

Franklin Park / 08823 and the Griggstown-Middlebush-Blackwells Mills rural west of the township were not systematically searched beyond Route 27; professional offices there are few and often list Kendall Park or Princeton addresses.
No government, school, hospital, bank, food-service or retail (group B/C/D) businesses were collected in this round - the brief scoped this zone to group A (professional and office services).
